indicators.label: Population (denominator basis)
indicators.description: For 2006, the full resident population. For 2019, the collected-person effectif that is the published percentage basis.
indicators.method: Use the published regional total for each wave without adjustment.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Thirteen ADM1 regions on the geoBoundaries 2017 boundary, shared by both waves. The product reports no cross-wave change statistic.
indicators.quality_notes: The 2006 and 2019 denominators differ in basis (full resident vs. collected person); the two waves are not differenced.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation (count)
indicators.description: People in the five affiliation categories (Animiste, Musulman, Catholique, Protestant, Autre).
indicators.method: 2006 only: sum the five published affiliation category counts. 2019 counts are withheld because the source publishes percentages only and no count is derived from a percentage.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Thirteen ADM1 regions on the geoBoundaries 2017 boundary, shared by both waves. The product reports no cross-wave change statistic.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation (%)
indicators.description: Share of the basis in the five affiliation categories.
indicators.method: 2006: 100 x affiliation count / full resident total. 2019: sum of the five published affiliation-category one-decimal shares, carried as published.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Thirteen ADM1 regions on the geoBoundaries 2017 boundary, shared by both waves. The product reports no cross-wave change statistic.
indicators.quality_notes: 2019 shares are one-decimal published values; a regional row may sum with the no-religion share to 99.9 or 100.1 within the derived rounding bound.

indicators.label: No religion (count)
indicators.description: People in the Sans religion category.
indicators.method: 2006 only: the published Sans religion count. 2019 counts are withheld.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Thirteen ADM1 regions on the geoBoundaries 2017 boundary, shared by both waves. The product reports no cross-wave change statistic.

indicators.label: No religion (%)
indicators.description: Sans religion as a share of the basis.
indicators.method: 2006: 100 x Sans religion count / full resident total. 2019: the published Sans religion one-decimal share.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Thirteen ADM1 regions on the geoBoundaries 2017 boundary, shared by both waves. The product reports no cross-wave change statistic.
indicators.quality_notes: The Sans religion category is inside the denominator and outside the affiliation numerator.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation share
visual_layers.description: Census religious affiliation share by region for 2006 and 2019.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: published regional value on the shared 2017 boundary
visual_layers.notes: 2006 values are exact-count shares; 2019 values are published one-decimal shares on the collected-person basis. The waves are shown side by side, not differenced.

visual_layers.label: No religion share
visual_layers.description: Sans religion share by region for 2006 and 2019.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: published regional value on the shared 2017 boundary
visual_layers.notes: No cross-wave change layer: the two waves use different denominator bases.
